חמישה דברים שלא ידעתם על יוון העתיקה: Five things you may not know about ancient Greece
הצצה לחמש עובדות פחות מוכרות על התרבות ו: A look at five lesser-known facts about culture and life in ancient Greece.
יוון העתיקה היא מקור השראה לתרבות המערבי: Ancient Greece has inspired Western culture through its contributions to philosophy, science, art and sport. Beyond the familiar stories, there are many fascinating, lesser-known details about its culture and everyday life.
באי פורוס בצפון יוון פעלו בתי ספר לאסטרו: Schools of astronomy and the exact sciences operated on the island of Poros in northern Greece. Astronomers such as Hipparchus and Claudius Ptolemy observed the sky and recorded the positions of the stars.
בתי המשפט ביוון העתיקה היו שונים מאוד מא: Courts in ancient Greece were very different from those we know today. Citizens from different walks of life served on juries, sometimes numbering in the hundreds.
3. תחרויות שירה ומוזיקה בדלפי: 3. Poetry and music competitions at Delphi
דלפי הייתה לא רק מרכז דתי, אלא גם מקום ח: Delphi was both a religious centre and an important venue for poetry and music competitions. The Pythian festival, held in honour of Apollo, included contests for singers and instrumentalists.
בספרטה היו לנשים זכויות ותפקידים שונים מ: Women in Sparta had very different rights and roles from women in Athens. Spartan women received physical education, competed in sports, owned property and ran businesses.
קנוסוס, בירת התרבות המינואית בכרתים, היי: Knossos, the centre of Minoan civilisation on Crete, had an advanced drainage system centuries ahead of its time.
